Greg Halloran, operations. We have not spoken before. So, what do you do?
Patricia Granizo. I run HR and internal communication for JEM System in Brazil.
Both of them? That is unusual. How big is the operation down there?
Our headcount is just under two hundred, and about half of that workforce is in the field. The plant managers report into operations, not into me.
Good, that is the same structure we have here. And what are you working on right now?
At the moment I am rolling out a new performance cycle across both sites, and my team is redesigning onboarding before we open in Texas.
Texas is mine. We should be talking every month, not every quarter. I will move you onto the people call.

Patricia, it is Greg. I know it is late for you, so I will keep this short. Starting in September we are moving the people review to a monthly call instead of a quarterly one, and I would like you on it every time. Twenty minutes, no deck, just the numbers and what you are working on. Nobody here expects a presentation. What we do expect is that you own the number and you can say what is behind it. If retention moved, say why it moved. If a rollout slipped, say what slipped and what you are doing about it. One more thing. You do not have to wait for me to ask. The people who do well on that call are the ones who bring the problem before somebody else finds it. Talk on Monday.

Let me tell you how I describe my job, because it took me years to get it short. I run people operations for the eastern region. That is the sentence that never changes. Then I add one line about what is on my desk this quarter, and this quarter it is a benefits change that affects about nine hundred people. Two sentences, and that is the whole introduction. What I used to do was tell people my entire history, and I could see them waiting for me to stop. Americans are not being rude when they cut in. They are trying to find the hook, the thing they can ask you about. So give them the hook early. Say what you run, say what you are working on, and then ask them the same question back.
